en.hubeali: H 14610 – A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Fazzaal, from Hanaan, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said: ‘
It does not matter whether the hostile one (Al-Nasibi) Prays or commits adultery (it’s the same), and this is the Verse which has been Revealed regarding them:
“[88:3] Labouring, (hostile one) [88:4] Entering into burning fire”.
en.sarwar: 162. A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Fazzaal, from Hanaan, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:
‘It does not matter whether the hostile one (Al-Nasibi) Prays or commits adultery (it’s the same),
and this is the Verse which has been Revealed regarding them:
“[88:3] Labouring, (hostile one) [88:4] Entering into burning fire”.
